title: Compass in paper
description: This texture pack changes maps into compass in paper!
body:
Welcome again!

Today (26 XI 2025) I came up with an idea.
So, we have maps.
Craftable by
8x paper
1x compass
Do you see any compass at map texture?
Me too. So i open Blockbench (next day maybe) and i change texture and name of map. Welcome... Compass in paper. And i change names too.


Whoa, im going better at descriptions

PL/ENG


PLEASE LEAVE LIKE, IT WAS HARD TO THINK IT (AND LATER I DO IT IN 0,5H)
